comment: What every machine on every account gets from fleet. Personal settings live in the account's ~/.agents tree (settings/*.json, mcp.json); lost.plus MCPs come from Auth's /api/services. The retired* lists are removed wherever fleet finds them. A harness's windows block replaces its other keys on Windows; one without it is not offered there.

harnesses.name: codex
harnesses.comment: For a standalone install `codex update` runs this same installer, but it gives up when it cannot tell how Codex was installed (seen with ~/.codex behind a symlink), so the installer then runs directly.
harnesses.update: codex update || curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | CODEX_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 sh

harnesses.name: t3
harnesses.install: set -e; t3="$HOME/.local/bin/t3"; [ -x "$t3" ] || curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh; case "$("$t3" service status)" in *"Status: installed"*) ;; *) "$t3" service install ;; esac

harnesses.name: ocx
harnesses.comment: The OpenCodex proxy. A bare `ocx service` installs its background service, or repairs one an earlier install left. The update swaps only the package, and fleet restarts the proxy once no turn is running; on Windows a running proxy locks its files, so fleet runs `ocx update`, which stops it, only while it is idle. Where npm's global folder is not writable (a system Node from a distro package), the package goes into ~/.local, whose bin is already on PATH; an install or update stays wherever the package already is. Only `ocx` is linked: the package also names its binary `opencodex`, which would collide with setup's picker in ~/.local/bin.
harnesses.install: p=$HOME/.local; [ -d "$p/lib/node_modules/@bitkyc08/opencodex" ] || { p=$(npm prefix -g); [ -w "$p/lib" ] || p=$HOME/.local; }; npm install -g --prefix "$p" --no-bin-links --allow-scripts=bun @bitkyc08/opencodex && mkdir -p "$p/bin" && ln -sf ../lib/node_modules/@bitkyc08/opencodex/bin/ocx.mjs "$p/bin/ocx" && "$p/bin/ocx" service
harnesses.update: p=$HOME/.local; [ -d "$p/lib/node_modules/@bitkyc08/opencodex" ] || { p=$(npm prefix -g); [ -w "$p/lib" ] || p=$HOME/.local; }; npm install -g --prefix "$p" --no-bin-links --allow-scripts=bun @bitkyc08/opencodex@latest && mkdir -p "$p/bin" && ln -sf ../lib/node_modules/@bitkyc08/opencodex/bin/ocx.mjs "$p/bin/ocx"

windows.install: npm install -g --allow-scripts=bun @bitkyc08/opencodex; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$(npm prefix -g)\ocx.cmd" service; exit $LASTEXITCODE
